text: PR 11 is on main by merge commit; the merge flow is ruled: squash into bleeding, merge bleeding into main [[ci-runs-each-workflow-only-when]]. The shared identity service is PR 12 [[shared-identity]] and the auth block is PR 13 [[audit-configuration-in-the-syntax]], both gated on their suites and a review. Release 0.5.2 follows both [[live-instance]]. Slice 1 of Human Agent Link waits on its push [[rebuild-ellanor-on-ordo-now-to]].
